name: Morne Trois Pitons National Park
description: Morne Trois Pitons National Park covers about 7,000 hectares of rainforest in the mountainous heart of Dominica, in the Caribbean. Its steep, volcanic landscape holds fumaroles, hot springs, lakes and the Boiling Lake. Hikers can cross the steaming Valley of Desolation, swim in Titou Gorge, or visit Emerald Pool beneath the 1,342-metre peak that gives the park its name.
